integrity: Mathematical claims were analytically derived and regression-tested; no external independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only Euclidean right prisms of three-dimensional convex bodies formed from planar bases and positive axial segments.
For power-of-two polygonal side counts the planar polygonal minimizing classification is not asserted.
The polygonal specialization relies on the independently cited planar Reinhardt classification of Akiyama and Kamae.
Possible unindexed earlier stereological width-deviation optimization remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp directional-width deviation and exact shape–height rigidity of right prisms
